ⓐMy name is Jihun. My best friend is Minsu. Minsu and ⓑI love rock music. ⓒWe are members of the school band Rock It. ⓓI play the guitar, and Minsu plays the drums. ⓔWe are not good players, but we have so much fun together. With Minsu, I laugh all the time. Together, we are happy.
questions.explanation: ⓐ 'My name is Jihun'이므로 Jihun을 가리킴 / ⓑ 'Minsu and I love rock music'에서 I(나, Jihun)와 Minsu를 함께 지칭 / ⓒ 'We are members'에서 We는 Jihun과 Minsu / ⓓ 'I play the guitar'에서 I는 Jihun이고, 'Minsu plays the drums'에서 Minsu는 드럼을 맞음 / ⓔ 'We are not good players'에서 We는 밴드 멤버들(Rock It members)을 가리킴

options: She is always by Tim's side.
She likes playing with Tim's friends.
She always stays at home on the weekend.
questions.question:
다음 Hope에 대한 설명 중 대화의 내용과 일치하는 것은?

[지문]
Karl: How are you doing, Tim?
Tim: Not bad. How about you, Karl?
Karl: I'm good! Oh, that's your guide dog Hope, right? She's like your best friend.
Tim: Yeah, she's always with me, even at school.
Karl: What does she do in class?
Tim: She mostly sleeps in class, but the teachers don't mind.
Karl: What do you do with her on weekends?
Tim: We go to the park and play together. We have lots of fun.
questions.explanation: ① She doesn't sleep in class. - 오답. 'She mostly sleeps in class'라고 명시됨 / ② She is always by Tim's side. - 정답. 'she's always with me, even at school'에서 확인 / ③ She doesn't like going outside. - 오답. 'We go to the park and play together'라고 했으므로 밖에 가기를 좋아함 / ④ She likes playing with Tim's friends. - 오답. Tim과 함께 노는 것이지, Tim의 친구들과 노는 것은 아님 / ⑤ She always stays at home on the weekend. - 오답. 'We go to the park and play together'라고 했음

questions.question:
다음 글의 빈칸 어디에도 들어갈 수 없는 단어는?

[지문]
My name is Tim. Hope is my guide dog and my best friend. She is ______ by my side. She ______ goes to school with me. Is she a ______ student? Well, she mostly sleeps in class, but the teachers don't mind. On weekends, we go to the park and play together. With Hope, I feel ______ and strong. We are ______ happy.
questions.explanation: 첫 번째 빈칸: 'She is even by my side' 또는 'She is always by my side' - 'even', 'always' 가능 / 두 번째 빈칸: 'She even goes to school' 또는 'She always goes to school' - 'even', 'always' 가능 / 세 번째 빈칸: 'Is she a good student?' - 'good' 가능 / 네 번째 빈칸: 'I feel free and strong' 또는 'I feel happy and strong' - 'free' 가능 / 다섯 번째 빈칸: 'We are happy' 또는 'We are always happy' - 'together'는 불가능. 'together'는 부사로 함께라는 뜻이지, 형용사처럼 쓰여 'are' 다음에 올 수 없음

questions.question:
다음 글의 ⓐ~ⓔ 중 흐름상 어색한 것은?

[지문]
I'm Hannah. ⓐ Mrs. Schmidt, my neighbor, is a dear friend to me. She is a great listener, and I often talk with her. ⓑ She is also a good speaker, and she talks a lot. ⓒ She just nods and smiles at me. ⓓ Sometimes I'm sad, and she bakes some cookies for me. ⓔ Her cookies are yummy, and I feel all right, like magic. With Mrs. Schmidt, I feel at home. Together, we are happy.
questions.explanation: ⓐ Hannah가 Mrs. Schmidt를 소개하는 부분으로 자연스러움 / ⓑ 'She is also a good speaker, and she talks a lot'는 어색함. Mrs. Schmidt는 'great listener'인데 갑자기 'good speaker'라고 하고 '말을 많이 한다'고 함. ⓒ에서 'She just nods and smiles at me'라고 했으므로 모순. Mrs. Schmidt는 많이 말하지 않는 사람임. 따라서 ⓑ가 흐름을 방해함 / ⓒ 'She just nods and smiles at me' - Mrs. Schmidt가 많이 말하지 않고 고개를 끄덕이며 미소 짓는 것으로 자연스러움 / ⓓ 슬플 때 쿠키를 구워주는 것으로 자연스러움 / ⓔ 쿠키가 맛있어서 기분이 좋아지는 것으로 자연스러움
